  • Perform technical site assessments and train collection center staff on collection requirements and attend site audits as required
  • Provide Quality Systems support by participating in deviation activities and impact/investigation assessments for cell collection centers.
  • Work with Quality Assurance and other internal business partners to monitor and assess vendor performance and capacity after site launch.
  • Manage rollout of process changes to assigned sites.
  • Collect VOC (voice of customer) and VOB (voice of business) feedback used for continuous operations improvement
  • Collect and enter data into electronic data management systems
  • Represent the department on cross-functional project teams, as requested.
  • Comply with applicable SOP’s and regulations.

Demonstrated skills and competencies

Experience Required:

  • Experience in Apheresis Operations Management, QA Operations, GMP production, GTP or other relevant operational areas
  • Breadth of experience in regulated (GxP) environment, understanding of HTA (either hospital or pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical company)
  • Experience working with critical raw material suppliers or contract manufacturing organizations
  • Has successfully worked in a team-based environment.
  • Experience in delivering process improvements, ideally in processes for qualification, training, and management of external cell procurement (Apheresis) suppliers.
  • Undergraduate degree in related science or nursing
  • Be fluent in English and Portuguese

Experience Preferred:

  • Experience working in Apheresis, Cellular Therapy or Stem Cell Transplant programs
  • Experience in an operational role for supplier qualification and management of external Apheresis, Cellular Therapy or Stem Cell Transplant programs.
  • Experience managing contracts with external apheresis providers.
  • Prior customer facing role in pharmaceutical/biotech industry
  • Advanced degree in related science or nursing (P)

Skills/Specialist knowledge

  • Ability to rapidly solve problems and deal with organizational complexity
  • Ability to prioritize and complete work with sense of urgency based on criticality
  • Medical, scientific and clinical knowledge
  • Knowledge of applicable regulations and standards
  • High attention to detail skills
  • High organization skills with ability to multi-task several tasks in parallel
  • Customer-centricity — Consider the impacts of decisions on the customer (treatment centre), striving to ensure that process changes improve and do not impede customer service when possible, while ensuring compliance with regulations
  • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills to communicate effectively across all levels within the organization and multiple cultures

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We’re looking for a  Senior Data Scientist to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:

  • Who gets funded
  • How and when we collect
  • Where we allocate risk capital

You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency. Your focus:  deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.

Specifically, you will:

  • Model borrower risk : Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud : Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions : Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we know  who to contact,  how , and  when .
  • Design experiments : Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work : Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage : Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of  SQL ,  Python , and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
  • Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
  • Solid understanding of business economics: marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.

Nice to have:

  • Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
  • Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).

Languages:

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Company & Product

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.

About Role:

As a Technical Support Engineer you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program.

Responsibilities:

● Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers

● Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g. workarounds for product issues and additional features)

● Manage critical issues that impact customer’s business

● Work with R&D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product

● Present complex technical information about the product to the customers

● Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community

● Work with Linux shell, RestAPI, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents

Work Hours : US East business hours (from 5PM to 2 AM).

Main Skills (What You’ve Already Accomplished...So Far):

● You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications

● You have experience with troubleshooting web applications

● You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level

● You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, BusinessObjects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas

● You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana

● You are familiar with Linux

● You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers

Nice to have:

● Experience with virtualization and cloud services (AWS, vSphere)

● Web development background and/or programming familiarity ( specifically JavaScript)

● Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Hadoop

● Experience with RestAPI

● Networking knowledges

description:
O Especialista Fiscal será responsável por garantir a correta apuração de tributos indiretos, bem como a elaboração e transmissão das obrigações acessórias, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação tributária. Atuará na interpretação de normas, análise e conciliação de contas contábeis relacionadas a tributos, além de revisar processos fiscais e propor melhorias.   • Desenvolver melhorias contínuas nos processos fiscais para otimizar tempo, reduzir riscos e garantir compliance.
  • Apoiar a gestão com relatórios gerenciais, pareceres técnicos e análises estratégicas.
  • Assegurar conformidade fiscal nos sistemas corporativos (SAP Business One – vivência obrigatória).

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou Administração.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na área Fiscal em nível Pleno ou Sênior.
  • Conhecimento avançado em legislação tributária e regimes Lucro Real, Presumido e Simples Nacional.
  • Excel avançado e experiência prática em relatórios gerenciais.
  • Vivência obrigatória com SAP Business One.

Diferenciais:

  • Especialização em legislação tributária ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil analítico, proatividade e habilidade para atuar de forma consultiva com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Local e regime de trabalho:

  • Votorantim/SP – Modelo híbrido.
  • Horário: Segunda a quinta-feira, das 08h às 18h, e sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h.
  • Salário: A combinar (informe sua pretensão salarial na candidatura)
  • Benefícios: Cartão Caju (multibenefício), convênio médico Unimed, convênio odontológico, vale-transporte, alimentação no local, PPR, TotalPass.

Se você busca um desafio técnico de alto nível na área Fiscal e quer atuar em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, qualidade e segurança tributária, esta vaga é para você!

title: District Commercial Manager
description:
1. Sobre nós

Keeta , a subsidiária internacional da Meituan - a gigante global de entregas - tem a missão de revolucionar a entrega de alimentos e produtos de consumo em todo o mundo. Com nossa crença principal: “Ajudamos as pessoas a comer melhor, a viver melhor”, estamos levando a inovação para o cenário global!

2. Responsabilidades

  • Formação e capacitação de equipes : Ajudar a Keeta a estabelecer uma equipe de vendas de entrega de alimentos em novas cidades, começando do zero para impulsionar a expansão dos negócios. Por meio de modelos sistemáticos de treinamento e capacitação individual ou em grupo, aprimore rapidamente os recursos da equipe e garanta o cumprimento das metas comerciais.
  • Desenvolvimento e otimização de sistemas : estabeleça e mantenha canais de comunicação fluidos dentro e fora da equipe. Otimize continuamente os mecanismos operacionais da equipe com base nos diferentes estágios de desenvolvimento dos negócios para fortalecer a experiência profissional da equipe.
  • Integração cultural e formação de equipes: demonstre a capacidade de gerenciar equipes multiculturais com eficácia e formar uma equipe de alto desempenho que se alinhe aos valores fundamentais da empresa.
  • Definição e alinhamento de metas : Combine os requisitos da liderança sênior com a situação real da equipe, realize avaliações abrangentes e forneça feedback, esclareça os objetivos do trabalho e defina metas em fases de acordo com os cronogramas.
  • Gerenciamento e acompanhamento de processos : utilize uma estrutura madura de procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOP) para garantir operações tranquilas na linha de frente. Ajuste prontamente as estratégias com base no progresso dos negócios para garantir que o gerenciamento de processos atenda aos requisitos.
  • Obtenção e revisão de resultados : garanta que os objetivos de trabalho sejam alcançados com sucesso. Realize revisões dos processos de trabalho, explore métodos mais eficientes, resuma experiências e acumule percepções valiosas para trabalhos futuros.
  • Gerenciamento e otimização do tempo : defina claramente as prioridades de gerenciamento do tempo para a função e os diferentes níveis e otimize o gerenciamento do tempo pessoal com base nas circunstâncias reais.

3. Requisitos básicos

  • Experiência em gerenciamento: tem experiência em gerenciamento de equipes de vendas, com desempenho excepcional em outra empresa no último ano.
  • Métodos de liderança de equipes : capacidade de articular claramente métodos para liderar equipes para o sucesso, com experiência comprovada e replicável em mercados estrangeiros.
  • Compartilhamento de experiências : compartilhe ativamente experiências de trabalho e forneça sugestões de melhorias práticas para ajudar a equipe a aprimorar rapidamente suas capacidades.
  • Pensamento estratégico : possua uma mentalidade holística com a capacidade de planejar claramente os caminhos de desenvolvimento dos negócios e da equipe. Ao enfrentar desafios, identifique com precisão as causas básicas e coordene a sede e as várias equipes para resolver os problemas rapidamente.
  • Foco no desenvolvimento de talentos : Priorize o crescimento de talentos, tendo atuado anteriormente como instrutor corporativo ou estabelecido um sistema de treinamento dentro da equipe.
  • Motivação e resiliência : demonstrar forte ambição e profissionalismo, disposição para se desafiar e capacidade de lidar com pressões relacionadas ao trabalho de forma eficaz.
  • Proficiência em idiomas : Fluente em inglês e português (fala, audição, leitura e escrita), com capacidade de adaptação a trabalhos e viagens de longo prazo no exterior.

4. Destaques do trabalho

Junte-se a nós para testemunhar o rápido crescimento do negócio global de entrega de alimentos da Meituan e vivenciar em primeira mão a transformação do setor e os milagres do crescimento. Você colaborará com uma equipe diversificada e de classe mundial, promovendo o pensamento inovador, expandindo sua perspectiva internacional e aprofundando sua experiência. Não se trata apenas de um emprego, mas de uma oportunidade inigualável de crescimento pessoal, de valorização pessoal e de inovação empresarial global.

title: Data Scientist
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Data Scientist will be a key contributor in designing and implementing advanced pricing models that drive revenue performance, customer value, and competitive positioning. The role involves full lifecycle model development, including data exploration, feature engineering, model building, simulation, and integration with pricing systems.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and deploy machine learning and statistical models to support pricing decisions, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization.

Conduct data exploration and wrangle large, complex datasets related to bookings, customer behavior, ship inventory, pricing, promotions, and competitive dynamics.

Collaborate with revenue management, analytics, and finance teams to define modeling requirements, test model scenarios, and ensure solutions align with business goals.

Apply pricing science and economics concepts to improve segmentation, elasticity estimation, and inventory control decisions.

Assist in building simulation tools and pricing engines that operationalize models in real-time or batch environments.

Collaborate with data engineers to define data requirements and ensure model-ready pipelines.

Document methodologies, assumptions, and model limitations clearly for technical and business audiences.

Guide data developers to ensure data is accurate and consumable for data science projects

Provide executive-level summaries, visualizations, and recommendations for the senior leadership team.

Stay current on data science best practices and tools.

Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related field.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 2 years of experience in a data science or quantitative role, ideally with exposure to pricing, forecasting, or optimization.

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

  • Experience building models using Python, R, or similar programming languages.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and large-scale data manipulation.
  • Familiarity with optimization libraries, simulation frameworks, or revenue management systems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices, including model monitoring, deployment pipelines, and reproducibility.
  • Strong foundation in predictive modeling, time series, and price elasticity estimation.
  • Working knowledge of pricing concepts such as demand curves, overbooking, dynamic pricing, and segmentation.
  • Experience with version control - GitHub, cloud environments - AWS, and productionizing models is a plus.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A self-starter with strong problem-solving skills and a team-first mindset.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About Singular

Singular is a leader in mobile marketing analytics, helping top brands unify marketing data, measure performance, and optimize growth.

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to take ownership of our GTM tech stack, streamline systems and processes, and ensure our tools and data work in perfect sync to drive smarter, faster decision-making across sales and marketing.

About the Role

As the Revenue Operations Manager, you will own and optimize our entire go-to-market (GTM) tech stack. You’ll be the architect and the mechanic, making sure our systems (like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, Clay, Chili Piper, Gong, etc.) work in harmony, support efficient workflows, and surface the right insights to drive growth.

If you’re passionate about eliminating bloat, streamlining tools, and enabling teams to move fast, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and optimize our GTM tech stack—evaluating tool usage, reducing redundancy, and integrating platforms for seamless data flow
  • Serve as SFDC administrator and power user: manage workflows, fields, objects, and automation to ensure our CRM supports sales, marketing, and customer success
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and CS teams to design efficient processes across lead routing, scoring, attribution, pipeline hygiene, and reporting
  • Build and maintain reports/dashboards that help us track key metrics (e.g., pipeline velocity, conversion rates, campaign ROI)
  • Lead tool onboarding and offboarding, including vendor management and training
  • Be the go-to connector between systems, solving data gaps, syncing issues, and ensuring reliable reporting
  • Stay ahead of new features and capabilities across our GTM tools, constantly improving how we work
  • Continuously analyze GTM data across the funnel to identify trends, test hypotheses, and propose actionable improvements across sales, marketing, and customer touchpoints
  • Support forecasting, capacity planning, and performance analysis to help leadership make informed, data-driven decisions

What You Bring to the Role

  • Proven experience managing GTM tools, especially Salesforce, HubSpot, and at least 2–3 of the following: Apollo, Clay, Chili Piper, Gong
  • Strong experience in B2B SaaS GTM models, ideally supporting both SLG and PLG motions
  • Hands-on SFDC admin experience with the ability to build and troubleshoot workflows, custom fields, automation, and integrations
  • Strong understanding of B2B revenue operations and the connection between sales, marketing, and customer success
  • Ability to simplify complex tech ecosystems and eliminate unnecessary tools or processes
  • Analytical mindset: you know your way around dashboards, attribution, and pipeline metrics
  • Comfortable rolling up your sleeves but also thinking strategically about how tech can unlock growth
  • Curious, fast learner, and a proactive problem-solver

Bonus Points

  • One or more of the following Salesforce certifications:
  • Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator
  • Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
  • Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
  • Experience with data tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, or similar)
  • Experience supporting ABM or multi-touch attribution models

Equal Opportunity

As a proud equal opportunity employer, we're committed to hiring top talent regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We don't just accept differences — we celebrate you being who you are for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields

EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: ML / Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who can take predictive models from concept to production. The ideal candidate thrives on building, deploying, and maintaining ML solutions that deliver measurable business impact. While the primary focus is on ML model development, deployment, and monitoring , experience in data engineering —especially in handling large, complex datasets—is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Model Development & Deployment – Design, build, and deploy machine learning models using Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Time Series Forecasting – Apply advanced time series techniques (ARIMA, SARIMA, Prophet, LSTM/RNNs) to forecast and model temporal data.
  • MLOps – Build and manage ML pipelines for training, validation, deployment, and monitoring using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, or cloud-based ML services.
  • Model Monitoring & Optimization – Track performance, detect drift or bias, and iterate on models to improve accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
  • Feature Engineering – Develop and select impactful features, especially for time series and structured datasets.
  • Exploratory Data Analysis & Visualization – Analyze datasets and communicate findings through clear visualizations (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly) to guide decision-making.
  • Collaboration – Work with product managers, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to align ML solutions with real-world needs.
  • (Bonus) Data Engineering – If you have strong SQL and ETL skills, help design and optimize data pipelines to ensure models have clean, reliable inputs.

Required Skills

  • Advanced Python programming for ML (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch).
  • Strong understanding of supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning techniques.
  • Expertise in time series forecasting and handling temporal data.
  • Experience with MLOps practices for production-scale deployments.
  • Familiarity with cloud ML services (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Cloud AI Platform).
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Solid SQL skills and experience with data extraction/transformation.
  • Knowledge of modern data engineering tools (Airflow, Spark, dbt, Snowflake, or similar).
  • Experience with CI/CD for ML workflows.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Previsão de formação a partir de dez/2026

title: Project Manager
description:
We're Hiring: Project Manager - Luxury Interior Fit-Out | KSA & UAE Projects

ALEC FITOUT, a division of ALEC Holdings and part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD), is a leading specialist in high-end interior fit-out and refurbishment projects across the hospitality, commercial, cultural, and retail sectors. We bring visionary interiors to life through precision execution and world-class craftsmanship.

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead and deliver high-quality fitout projects in the UAE and KSA. The role involves managing the full project lifecycle, ensuring timely, budget-friendly, and high-standard execution. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in luxury hospitality, cultural and themed entertainment sectors.

  • Please note that this role may be assigned to ALEC FITOUT projects located either in the Saudi Arabia (KSA) or the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
  • The position requires a six-day working week , which is mandatory for all site-based roles.
  • Successful candidates must be eligible to obtain a work visa for either KSA or UAE.

Your Role:

  • Lead and manage luxury interior fit-out projects from concept to flawless delivery.
  • Oversee planning, procurement, budgeting, and execution.
  • Align cross-functional teams, subcontractors, and consultants toward excellence.
  • Champion HSE standards, risk management, and quality assurance at every phase.
  • Be the driving force behind timely approvals, smooth coordination, and design perfection.

What You’ll Need:

  • 12+ years’ experience in construction, with at least 5 in luxury fit-out project management.
  • Strong portfolio managing complex, high-spec interior projects.
  • Proven ability to handle multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Core Technical Skills:

  • Fit-Out Project Execution
  • Project Lifecycle Management
  • Luxury Interiors
  • Contract & Commercial Management
  • Stakeholder Coordination

Please ensure to attach your CV in English when applying.

title: Auditor de Processos
description:
Process Auditor

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and proactive Process Auditor to join our team. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about process optimization, risk mitigation, and internal controls. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence and compliance across various business units.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audit Planning : Define audit scope, objectives, and methodology, identifying risk areas and creating detailed audit plans.
  • Process Evaluation : Collect and analyze systemic data to identify inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Internal Controls Review : Assess the effectiveness of internal controls across business processes.
  • Compliance Verification : Ensure adherence to relevant laws, regulations, standards, and internal policies.
  • Recommendations Development : Collaborate with audited areas to propose actionable solutions and process improvements.
  • Reporting : Document findings and prepare comprehensive reports with recommendations for stakeholders.
  • Action Follow-up : Monitor the implementation of corrective actions, ensuring timely and effective resolution of identified issues.
  • Internal Investigations : Conduct investigations based on reports received through the company’s Compliance channel.
  • Consulting Support : Provide guidance to internal teams on process and risk-related inquiries.
  • Methodology Enhancement : Continuously improve audit methods and practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
  • Fluent English (required for meetings, presentations, and reporting).
  • Minimum of 2 years of professional experience, preferably in internal audit or Big Four firms.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
  • Broad understanding of various business and industrial areas.
  • Clear and effective communication across all organizational levels.
  • Proactive approach to learning and exploring diverse topics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data analysis tools (e.g., Python, Power BI).
  • Knowledge of corporate investigations.
  • Intermediate Spanish.
  • Certifications such as CIA (Certified Internal Auditor) and/or CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner).

Você será responsável por construir e evoluir nossa arquitetura de dados, com foco principal em Data Warehouses de alta qualidade seguindo as melhores práticas de star schema. Esperamos alguém que não apenas domine as ferramentas, mas que tenha visão arquitetural e compromisso com excelência técnica.

  • Projetar e implementar Data Warehouses utilizando modelagem dimensional Star Schema

  • Implementar Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) e modelos incrementais conforme necessário
  • Criar e otimizar agregações e reports para análises de negócio
  • Estabelecer convenções de nomenclatura e padrões de documentação técnica

Engenharia de Dados & Pipelines

Qualidade & Governança

  • Implementar testes de qualidade de dados
  • Estabelecer controle de versão e práticas de code review
  • Criar documentação técnica e catálogos de dados
  • Monitorar SLAs de disponibilidade e integridade dos dados

Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência em engenharia de dados com foco em Data Warehousing
  • Expertise comprovada em modelagem dimensional Kimball e Star Schema
  • Proficiência avançada em SQL (queries complexas, window functions, CTEs, performance tuning)
  • Experiência sólida com dbt (macros, tests, documentation, packages)
  • Domínio de Airflow para orquestração de workflows
  • Experiência prática com AWS (Glue, Athena, S3, RDS, IAM e outras tecnologias)
  • Python intermediário/avançado para automação e scripts
  • Git
  • Containers
  • Linux

description:

O departamento de contabilidade da JBS S/A possui um clima agradável e familiar. Um ambiente leve, porém com responsabilidade aos prazos a serem cumpridos, pois somos uma Companhia de capital aberto na Bolsa de Valores do Brasil e Estados Unidos.

description:

Join NFQ!

We are a global consultancy specialized in business, technology, and operations. We offer an integrated vision that covers the entire value chain of organizations. Our team includes over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices.

At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Close to clients .

We are looking for a Java Software Engineer with strong technical expertise, deep understanding of backend architecture, and experience in the financial sector to join a dynamic, fast-paced environment.   • 3+ years of backend development experience in Java (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud).

  • Knowledge of relational databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Experience in technical pre-sales or commercial engagements in banking projects.
  • Knowledge of financial products and markets: Derivatives, Fixed Income, FX, ETDs, and Energy.
  • Experience developing new treasury solutions.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK).
  • Spanish language skills.

What do we offer?

  • The opportunity to work in an international environment with potential mobility across global offices.
  • Continuous learning and development, with access to official certifications.
  • Language classes to support your global career.
  • A tailored career development plan with mentorship and merit-based growth.

CLT contract model , including:

Somos um time inquieto, criativo e movido por tecnologia . Aqui na Webmotors, inovação não é só discurso — é prática. Somos apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos com soluções escaláveis, modernas e que geram impacto real na vida das pessoas.

A Webmotors

A Webmotors existe para simplificar a jornada automotiva completa: da compra à venda, da assinatura ao cuidado com o veículo. São mais de 30 anos de pioneirismo, em constante evolução e inovação. Atualmente, mais de 13 milhões de brasileiros acessam nossa plataforma todos os meses.

title: Analista de Comunicação Interna - PL
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF! Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance, da NWB, da OneFan e da X3M, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele? Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!

Missão do Cargo: Planejar, produzir e gerenciar conteúdo de ações de comunicação interna.

Sobre a posição no jogo:

Como Analista de Comunicação Interna - PL você entrará em campo, com as seguintes atividades:

  • Redigir conteúdos institucionais para diversos formatos e canais internos (Slack, TV corporativa, e-mail etc.);
  • Planejar e executar campanhas de comunicação com foco em cultura, engajamento, diversidade, segurança, entre outros temas transversais;
  • Gerenciar o calendário editorial da área e manter coerência entre mensagens e canais;
  • Coordenar a produção de peças com parceiros criativos e fornecedores;
  • Realizar análises de performance (engajamento, alcance, feedbacks) e propor melhorias baseadas em dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Formação completa em Comunicação Social, Marketing, Eventos, Relações Públicas e áreas afins;
  • Experiência anterior em comunicação interna;
  • Capacidade de atuar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas;
  • Excelência na comunicação escrita e visual;
  • Vivência em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas digitais corporativas;
  • Negociação com fornecedores;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de performance (ex: NPS, KPIs de engajamento);
  • Experiência com campanhas institucionais e narrativas de cultura;
  • Ferramentas gráficas (Canva, PPT avançado, pacote Adobe).

title: Senior Quantity Surveyor
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Quantity Surveyor for Luxury Fit-Out Projects

ALEC FITOUT, a division of ALEC Holdings and part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD), is a leading specialist in high-end interior fit-out and refurbishment projects across the hospitality, commercial, cultural, and retail sectors. We bring visionary interiors to life through precision execution and world-class craftsmanship.

ALEC FITOUT is seeking a specialized Senior Quantity Surveyor who will be responsible for overseeing all financial and contractual aspects of the project. You will play a critical role in ensuring the project is completed within budget while maintaining the highest standards of quality.

  • Please note that this role will be assigned to ALEC FITOUT projects located in the UAE & KSA.
  • The position requires a six-day working week , which is mandatory for all site-based roles.
  • Successful candidates must be eligible to obtain a work visa for UAE or KSA.

Your Role:

  • Manage commercial and contractual aspects of luxury fit-out projects.
  • Develop and maintain tender budgets and procurement strategies.
  • Lead subcontractor tendering, negotiations, and manage project claims.
  • Oversee cost control, progress invoicing, and financial reporting.
  • Lead and mentor the commercial team for successful project delivery.

What You’ll Need:

  • Degree in Quantity Surveying (or equivalent).
  • 8+ years’ experience, with 5+ years in luxury interior fit-out projects.
  • Proven skills in contract management, cost control, and subcontractor management.
  • Strong commercial awareness, leadership, and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent in English

Core Technical Skills:

  • Interior Fitout
  • Contract Management & Administration
  • Cost Control and Estimation
  • Procurement & Subcontractor Management
  • Risk Management
  • Financial Reporting

Please ensure to attach your CV in English when applying.

title: Analista Pl. de Qualidade Assegurada (Sistema Elétrico)
description:
O Analista de Qualidade Assegurada será responsável por investigar e solucionar problemas nos sistemas elétricos dos veículos, atuando desde a identificação da causa raiz até a validação de contramedidas. A posição envolve interface com fornecedores, áreas internas e a matriz na Coreia do Sul, além do desenvolvimento de testes, monitoramento de indicadores e auditorias.

Principais atividades:

  • Trabalhar soluções para problemas de qualidade nos sistemas elétricos do veículo, entendendo a causa raiz e, propondo e validando contramedidas em conjunto com as áreas de manufatura, fornecedores, área de pesquisa e desenvolvimento;
  • Monitorar assuntos de qualidade em geral baseado em indicadores, mantendo o controle dos problemas e ações de melhoria relacionadas aos diversos sistemas do veículo.
  • Investigar problemas por meio de testes e análise das peças falhadas, visita às concessionárias e aos fornecedores;
  • Desenvolver e propor testes de bancada e em veículo para reproduzir problemas experimentados pelos clientes e validar melhorias propostas;
  • Interpretar de normas e especificações dos componentes e sistemas com funcionamento discretos (sensores, atuadores, comandos);
  • Preparar e conduzir reuniões com os fornecedores locais, com a matriz da Hyundai na Coréia do Sul e fornecedores globais;
  • Garantir a qualidade das peças através do monitoramento da performance dos fornecedores;
  • Estabelecer plano de melhorias na cadeia de fornecedores baseado nos indicadores de qualidade;
  • Aprovar peças por meio das metodologias PPAP/ANPQP/ISIR;
  • Realizar auditoria de Processo em fornecedores.

Pré requisitos:

  • Formação em Engenharia de Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Mecatrônica, Automação, e correlatas;
  • Cursos técnico em Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica, Automação, Reparo de sistema elétricos automotivos ou manutenção mecânica;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimento em eletrônica embarcada: Funcionamento, montagem de componentes, teste e análise de falhas de componentes elétricos do veículo com foco em peças do sistema elétrico;
  • Pacote Office Completo e avançado( Excel, Powerpoint, Word);
  • Conhecimento e familiaridade com uso de equipamentos de medição e coleta de dados voltados para eletrônica: multímetros, osciloscópio, data loggers.

Será um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em redes / protocolos de comunicação automotivos: K-Line, CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.

Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.

Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes   Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.
Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma das maiores indústrias farmacêuticas da América Latina?

O que esperamos que tenha para concorrer a esta vaga:

Horário: Seg a Sex / Adm

Formato100% presencial

title: Coordenador de Conformidade e Contratos Aeroportuários
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Somos uma das principais concessionárias do setor aeroportuário, responsável pela operação e gestão comercial de um aeroporto internacional de grande porte. Buscamos constantemente inovar e elevar a experiência dos passageiros através de parcerias estratégicas e um mix comercial diferenciado e de alta qualidade.

Objetivo do Cargo

O Coordenador de Conformidade e Contratos Aeroportuários é um elo vital entre a administração do aeroporto e nosso ecossistema de parceiros comerciais. Este profissional é responsável por nutrir e fortalecer relacionamentos estratégicos com as marcas e lojistas, assegurando que as parcerias não apenas cumpram todos os requisitos legais e contratuais (conformidade), mas também atinjam seu máximo potencial comercial e estratégico. O foco está em transformar contratos em parcerias de sucesso duradouro.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Gestão de Relacionamento e Parcerias (60% do foco):

  • Atuar como o principal ponto de contato e gestor do relacionimento para um portfólio de parceiros e lojistas, construindo relações de confiança e colaboração.
  • Realizar reuniões de business review periódicas para analisar performance comercial, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e alinhar expectativas.
  • Proativamente identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de valor compartilhado com os parceiros, como ações promocionais conjuntas, eventos e melhorias operacionais.
  • Garantir a satisfação dos parceiros, atuando na rápida resolução de dúvidas, solicitações e eventuais conflitos, em colaboração com outras áreas (operações, marketing).
  • Onboarding estratégico de novos parceiros, facilitando sua integração ao ecossistema e às normas do aeroporto.

Conformidade e Gestão Contratual (40% do foco):

  • Garantir que a execução das parcerias comerciais esteja em estrita conformidade com o contrato, a legislação de aeroportos (normas ANAC) e o regulamento interno.
  • Traduzir cláusulas contratuais complexas em orientações claras e práticas para os parceiros, facilitando o cumprimento das obrigações.
  • Coordenar e acompanhar processos de licitações, com foco na atração de parceiros alinhados à estratégia e ao perfil do aeroporto.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos contratos (aditivos, renovação e realinhamentos), sempre com uma visão de manter e potencializar a parceria.
  • Realizar verificações e auditorias de conformidade, adotando uma postura de consultoria para correção de rotas, quando necessário.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Formação Necessária:

  • Bacharelado em Administração , Marketing , Economia ou Direito . Pós-graduação em Gestão Comercial, Varejo ou Negócios é um diferencial.

Experiência Profissional:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em cargos que combinem gestão de relacionamento com clientes/parceiros (Key Account Management) e gestão contratual/compliance .
  • Experiência comprovada em negociação e desenvolvimento de parcerias comerciais .
  • Experiência no setor de varejo, shopping centers, aeroportos ou em ambientes B2B com múltiplos parceiros é altamente desejável.

Conhecimentos Técnicos (Hard Skills):

  • Conhecimento sólido em gestão de contratos e processos licitatórios.
  • Noções avançadas de compliance e gestão de riscos em ambientes regulados.
  • Capacidade de analisar indicadores de desempenho comercial (KPIs) e dados financeiros.
  • Pacote Office avançado (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Habilidades excepcionais de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Capacidade de negociação e persuasão.
  • Perfil consultivo e orientado para soluções, com foco no ganha-ganha.
  • Proatividade e visão estratégica para enxergar oportunidades além do contrato.
  • Organização e resiliência para lidar com múltiplos parceiros e demandas simultâneas.
  • Ética e integridade inquestionáveis.

O que Oferecemos

  • Oportunidade única de atuar na gestão do relacionamento com marcas de grande porte em um ambiente aeroportuário internacional.
  • Um papel central e estratégico, com impacto direto nos resultados comerciais e na experiência do passageiro.
  • Plano de carreira e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.
  • Pacote de benefícios competitivo (VR/VA, Assistência Médica, Assistência Odontológica, Seguro de Vida, PLR, etc.).
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, colaborativo e desafiador.

title: Purchase Supervisor
description:
About the job:

100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

The Purchase Lead will be responsible for overseeing the procurement process of aviation parts, equipment, and services. This role involves strategic sourcing, supplier management, inventory control, and ensuring compliance with aviation regulations. The Purchase will work closely with various departments, including maintenance, engineering, logistics and operations, to ensure the efficient and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services.

Strategic Sourcing:

•Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans to optimize procurement processesand supplier relationships.

•Conduct market research and analysis to identify potential suppliers and evaluatetheir capabilities.

•Develop sourcing strategies to achieve cost savings, improve quality, and ensuresupply chain resilience.

•Lead the selection and negotiation process for key suppliers, ensuring alignmentwith organizational goals and objectives.

Procurement Management:

•Oversee the procurement of aviation parts, equipment, and services, ensuringadherence to specifications and timelines.

•Manage the end-to-end procurement process, including order placement, suppliercoordination, and delivery management with logistic department.

•Implement best practices and processes to enhance procurement efficiency andeffectiveness.

Supplier and Vendor Management:

•Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with suppliers and vendors.

•Monitor and manage supplier performance, addressing any issues related todelivery, quality, or service.

•Conduct regular reviews and audits of supplier performance and implementimprovement plans as needed.

Inventory Management:

•Oversee inventory levels of aviation parts and equipment to ensure adequate supplyand minimize stockouts.

•Implement inventory control measures and optimize inventory turnover rates.

• Coordinate with maintenance and engineering teams to forecast demand and manage inventory accordingly.

Work experience:

Proven experience in procurement or purchasing within the aviation industry, with a strong understanding of aviation parts, equipment, and services.

Educational:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Aviation Management, or a related field. Advanced certifications or degrees may be advantageous.

Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory

Technical Skills :

Excel, Outlook, ERPs, PowerBI

title: (Banco de Talentos) Coordenação de Produção
description:
Comece aqui. Veja onde pode chegar.

Curitiba - PR

No Electrolux Group, uma empresa líder global no segmento de eletrodomésticos, nós buscamos todos os dias transformar a vida para o melhor para os nossos consumidores, nossos colaboradores, e nosso planeta. Nós compartilhamos ideias e perspectivas para, juntas e juntos, podermos desenvolver soluções que entreguem uma vida mais agradável e sustentável.

Venha e junte-se a nós como você é, porque acreditamos que pontos de vista diversos nos tornam mais fortes e inovadores. Dentro da nossa comunidade global com pessoas de mais de cem países, nós ouvimos uns aos outros, e ativamente colaboramos e crescemos em diversidade e inclusão.

Junte-se a nós na nossa incrível missão de construir a casa do futuro!

Tudo sobre a função:

Aqui no Electrolux Group, nós vamos muito mais além da melhoria contínua, e isso inclui desafiar nossos próprios processos de trabalho. Por todo o mundo, e por muitas plantas e setores, nossas equipes multifuncionais estão trabalhando proativamente para otimizar o potencial de nosso sistema de manufatura. Atuando de maneira dinâmica, ágil e focada na satisfação do consumidor, as nossas equipes de Produção contribuem para garantir que a Electrolux continue na vanguarda da inovação em produtos e serviços.

O que você vai fazer:

Seu maior desafio será liderar o time de operadores de Manufatura, garantindo os recursos necessários para o atendimento da programação de produção diária sem perder o foco na segurança de sua equipe e nos elevados padrões de qualidade da Electrolux. Se você tem boa capacidade de organização e análise, facilidade para se comunicar e colaborar, e consegue unir a sua visão estratégica com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa, essa é a sua chance! Ajude a Electrolux a continuar entregando experiências extraordinárias, e nós vamos te ajudar a voar muito mais alto.

Algumas responsabilidades serão:

- Treinar os membros da equipe, capacitando eles para suas funções conforme as metodologias e procedimentos internos da empresa;

- Lidar com procedimentos diários como controle de ponto, atestados médicos, distribuição de tarefas e turnos de trabalho, entre outros;

- Atuar na prevenção de acidentes de trabalho, monitorando o seguimento das Regras de Ouro de Segurança;

- Motivar a equipe, reduzindo o absenteísmo e o turnover de funcionários, e melhorando os resultados de Segurança, Qualidade, Entrega, Custo e Pessoas, sempre assegurando que todos estão trabalhando de acordo com os valores da Electrolux;

- Utilizar o EMS (Sistema de Manufatura Electrolux), baseado nas ferramentas e princípios de Lean Manufacturing.

Como parte da cultura de melhoria contínua, você participará de projetos e atividades de Lean Thinking (EMS / EAI).

Quem é você:

Você tem:

- Superior Completo e/ou Pós-Graduação, preferencialmente em Engenharia ou áreas Tecnológicas voltadas à indústria ou afins;

- Experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes (mínimo de 30 pessoas);

- Experiência com rotinas e processos de linha de produção e/ou montagem de produtos;

- Experiência em projetos de melhoria contínua com base na aplicação das técnicas e princípios do Lean Manufacturing;

- Conhecimento nas ferramentas da indústria 4.0;

- Desejável experiência e conhecimento em legislações aplicáveis em gestão de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente em empresas de grande porte;

- Pacote Office intermediário;

- Desejável Inglês intermediário.

Onde você vai estar:

Você vai atuar em uma das plantas da Electrolux em Curitiba que funcionam como base para equipes de produção completamente focadas em transformar a vida para o melhor através da excelência no trabalho.

Com o compromisso de criar uma cultura inclusiva e de cuidado com o bem-estar de todos, oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:

- Descontos nos produtos e serviços da Electrolux;

- Plano de saúde e seguro de vida;

description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!

About the client

The client is a global software platform that powers collaboration for millions of developers. Their team focuses on enabling secure, reliable, and scalable authorization systems. They are modernizing their architecture from a monolithic system to distributed microservices, with a strong culture of collaboration, proactivity, and delivering high-impact features in fast sprint cycles.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Authorization Platform) with deep expertise in Go and enterprise-scale systems. This is a high-impact role contributing to the large-scale migration of authorization logic from a Rails monolith into Go-based microservices, while designing secure, performant, and observable systems.

You will take technical ownership of critical services, collaborate across distributed teams, and be expected to deliver production-ready code quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy features for the Go-based authorization microservices.
  • Lead migration of authorization logic from a Ruby on Rails monolith into standalone Go services.
  • Architect scalable and secure authorization flows (RBAC, ABAC, deny-by-default).
  • Ensure observability: implement logging, metrics, and tracing for reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineering teams to ensure seamless integrations.
  • Participate in sprint rituals (standups, planning, demos) and proactively own tasks from the backlog.
  • Document decisions and share knowledge to improve cross-team collaboration.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of professional backend development experience in enterprise-scale systems.
  • 7+ years of production experience with Go (Golang) – strong command of idioms, concurrency, and microservices architecture.
  • Hands-on Ruby on Rails experience , especially with reading/modifying code during migrations.
  • Deep knowledge of authorization models (RBAC, ABAC) and security best practices (deny-by-default, audit logging).
  • Strong experience with MySQL or other relational databases.
  • Observability practices: metrics, logging, tracing.
  • Ability to ship a production-ready pull request within the first two weeks .
  • Excellent communication skills – structured, clear, and able to explain technical trade-offs and architectural choices.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes and CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).
  • Experience in large-scale distributed systems .
  • Knowledge of Go authorization frameworks (OPA, Casbin, Authzed).

Conditions

  • 100% Remote role, with a 5-hour overlap required with UTC-4 (Eastern/Central Time).
  • Contractor role – 12-month contract, renewable.
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • Device provided by the client (no BYOD).

title: Technical Sales Specialist - Brazil
description:
Do you want to join a fast-growing life sciences company with innovative solutions that are changing the landscape of genomics research?

Are you ready to build relationships with industry leaders while accelerating revenue growth in cutting-edge genomic and automation technologies?

As a Technical Sales Specialist , you will leverage your technical expertise and sales acumen to develop new opportunities, engage key opinion leaders, and close sales in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will play a pivotal role in advancing life sciences research and enabling affordable healthcare solutions for all.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Sales Growth and Strategy:

  • Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed revenue targets in your territory.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new opportunities for MGI’s products and solutions.

Customer Engagement and Support:

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, customers, and industry stakeholders in academic, government, and private sectors.
  • Provide pre-sales consultation and post-sales support, ensuring customers achieve optimal results with MGI products.

Technical Expertise and Education:

  • Deliver technical presentations, seminars, and workshops to educate customers on product capabilities and applications.
  • Collaborate with Field Application Scientists, product managers, and R&D to provide comprehensive technical and promotional support.

Market Intelligence:

  • Gather and analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to inform product development and sales strategies.
  • Contribute to marketing efforts through trade shows, vendor events, and other promotional activities.

Reporting and Administration:

  • Maintain accurate CRM records (e.g., Salesforce), prepare sales forecasts, and provide regular activity reports.
  • Monitor sales metrics to evaluate performance and adjust strategies as needed.

ABOUT YOU

  • You thrive in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment where collaboration and innovation drive success.
  • Strong communicator with excellent presentation skills, able to engage both small and large audiences.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Passionate about advancing genomics and automation technologies to transform healthcare.

WHERE YOU WILL WORK

Brazil (São Paulo) :

  • Field-based role , eligible for remote work based in Brazil
  • Preferred location : São Paulo
  • Up to 50% travel across the territory to engage with customers and stakeholders, demonstrate and sell NGS instruments, attend regional events, and support market initiatives.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING US

Technical Expertise:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of NGS, DNA sequencing, RT-PCR, and molecular biology applications.
  • Hands-on experience with library preparation, lab automation, and system integration for sequencing workflows.

Sales Experience:

  • 5+ years of successful sales experience in life sciences, genomics, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales goals and develop long-term customer relationships.

Tech-Savvy Skills:

  • Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and MS Office Suite.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related field required; Master’s or advanced degree preferred.

Language:

  • English - advanced level
  • Spanish - intermediate/advanced knowledge desired

WHAT YOUR EDUCATION LOOKS LIKE

  • Master’s or Advanced Degree in life sciences or related fields preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree with significant technical and sales experience will also be considered.

HOW WE WILL REWARD YOU:

  • Comprehensive health insurance
  • Fitness allowance to support your wellness goals
  • Meal stipend to cover daily meal expenses
  • Dental Plan

ABOUT US

MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering high-quality genetic sequencers and advancing life sciences research. We’re dedicated to creating affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding regional operations across the Americas.

Ready to make an impact in life sciences and healthcare? Join us on this exciting journey toward affordable and effective solutions for all!

title: Técnico de Campo Júnior em Telecomunicações/Redes
description:
Descrição Sumária: Field Technician JR é o(a) profissional responsável pela manutenção e suporte operacional crítico, garantindo a continuidade e excelência na infraestrutura de dados. Em sua atuação, integra funções estratégicas como monitoramento de incidentes e a coordenação de respostas emergenciais, com o suporte em campo. Dessa forma, suas atribuições abrangem tanto a atividade técnica quanto a gestão de incidentes operacionais, sempre com foco na mínima interrupção dos processos e na melhoria contínua dos serviços.

Descrição Detalhada:

Atuar como apoio de O&M:

  • Executar configuração de equipamentos de rede sob a supervisão do nosso NOC.
  • Manutenção preventiva e corretiva da infraestrutura da planta interna da companhia, incluindo equipamentos, cabos, sistemas de comunicação e outros recursos relacionados.
  • Executar a manutenção em DGOs de fibras, trabalhando na recuperação de nossos links.
  • Realizar “site surveys” para levantamento do parque instalado.

Gerir a Fila de Tickets Online:

  • Supervisionar continuamente a fila de tickets críticos, definindo prioridades com base na urgência e no impacto operacional.
  • Assegurar que cada incidente seja direcionado à equipe técnica especializada para respostas ágeis e assertivas.

Reporte da Situação de Tickets Online:

  • Desenvolver e divulgar relatórios dinâmicos que refletem o status dos incidentes, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e o cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Fornecer informações críticas que facilitam a implementação imediata de ações corretivas.

Reunião diária com EAIMs Parceiras de Campo:

  • Participar de reuniões diárias para discutir desafios recentes, alinhar prioridades e definir planos de ação colaborativos com a equipe EAIM.

Escalonamento de Incidentes:

  • Avaliar a criticidade dos incidentes e, quando necessário, escalonar para níveis superiores de suporte ou para gestores especializados; garantindo que os incidentes sejam tratados com a urgência requerida, mantendo uma comunicação contínua com as áreas técnicas.

FCA dos Cases Encerrados:

  • Registrar soluções e ajustes implementados, estruturando um banco de conhecimento que auxilia na prevenção de falhas futuras.

Formação:

  • Graduado em Tecnologia Telecomunicações, Redes de Computadores, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas relacionadas.

Soft skills:

  • Ter senso crítico e analítico, promovendo alternativas inovadoras.
  • Iniciativa e proatividade.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal, para atuar com equipes técnicas e fornecedores.

Experiência profissional requerida:

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de incidentes ServiceNow;
  • Compreensão de KPIs, SLAs e metodologias ágeis de resolução de incidentes;
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de comunicação de dados, protocolos, equipamentos de comunicação e padrões do setor;
  • Instalação, desinstalação, manutenção e operação em equipamentos IP Switchs e Roteadores (CISCO e Juniper), DWDM e SDH (CIENA, INFINERA e NOKIA);
  • Instalação, operação e manutenção de cabeamentos ópticos e equipamentos em clientes fora da estação (sites de clientes e datacenters locais);

Como Data Engineering Manager você nos ajudará a conectar as frentes de produto, tecnologia e pessoas na estrutura de Data Plataform, sendo responsável pelas plataformas de missão crítica, gerenciando todo o fluxo de extrato do Brasil. title: Analista de Produtos Sênior

  • Participar do desenho de produtos, colaborando na definição de coberturas, assistências e estratégias de precificação e canais;

  • Realizar a manutenção dos produtos existentes, propondo ajustes operacionais, técnicos ou de comunicação;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos produtos, analisando indicadores como sinistralidade, rentabilidade e KPIs de experiência do cliente;

  • Desejável: experiência com análise de viabilidade financeira e business cases;

title: Engenheiro de Serviços
description:
O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Quem você é:

Você antecipa as necessidades dos clientes e fornece serviços que vão além de suas expectativas. Toma medidas rápidas e decisivas em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam os fatos. Você sempre mantém o objetivo em vista e faz um esforço extra para cumprir os prazos.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia elétrica, computação ou relacionada;
  • Experiência com sistemas de medição de vazão, especificamente para distribuição de gás natural;
  • Experiência com configuração e manutenção de computadores de vazão da linha Emerson (FB107, ROC 800);
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência com automação industrial;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Possuir CNH válido (categoria B);

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Conhecimento em calibração de transmissores e medidores.

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Freelance Weekend & Holiday Social Media Community Manager
description:
Weekend & Holiday Social Media Community Manager (Freelance)

Contract | Spin Master Brands | Remote

We’re looking for a thoughtful, creative, and quick-witted Community Manager to oversee weekend and holiday social engagement across Spin Master’s family of brands — including but not limited to PAW Patrol, Unicorn Academy, Rubik’s Cube, Kinetic Sand, and Spin Master Corporate.

Key Details:

  • Start: ASAP
  • Duration: Through December, with potential to extend
  • Schedule: ~3 hours/day on Saturdays & Sundays, including these specific weekdays:
  • Thanksgiving (11/27)
  • Day after Thanksgiving (11/28)
  • Christmas Eve (12/24)
  • Christmas (12/25)
  • New Years Eve (12/31)
  • New Years Day (1/01)
  • Rate: BRL$50-60/hour
  • NOTE: We are open to international candidates with excellent English and strong autonomy. This is a remote freelance position.

You’ll Be Responsible For:

  • Publishing Feed/Story content w/ native text and tools
  • Monitoring tags, comments, and DMs across platforms
  • Searching, flagging and responding to brand mentions, brand keywords and related conversations
  • Responding to timely or high opportunity moments
  • Flagging priority issues, trend spikes, or approvals as needed
  • Communicating clearly with our team — and sometimes, the C-suite

What We’re Looking For:

  • Creative confidence - especially in real-time posting and response, with ability to layout strong and engaging Stories and reposts.
  • Excellent written English and social-first copy instincts
  • Fluency in multiple brand voices — from teen-girl trends (Unicorn Academy) to heartfelt parental tone (PAW Patrol) to global fan hype (Rubik’s)
  • Discretion + professionalism — especially for our Spin Master Corporate handle, which frequently appears in partnership with Nickelodeon, Paramount, and press outlets like Entertainment Tonight and People
  • Experience in entertainment or toys — with the ability to adapt quickly to brand tone
  • Confidence communicating with leadership — this role sits close to high-visibility work and will occasionally require approvals from senior stakeholders
  • Ability and ease to collaborate quickly on real-time opportunities and gain alignment with c-level clients.

Pereira O'Dell is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participant in the US Federal E-Verify program. At this time, we are not accepting resumes or candidates from third-party vendors.

title: Coordenador de Implantação
description:
O Coordenador de Implantação de Software terá como objetivo principal Coordenar e garantir a execução eficiente dos projetos de implantação de software, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, escopo e qualidade, além de promover a integração entre equipes técnicas e clientes.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar projetos de implantação de software, desde o planejamento até a execução, garantindo que sejam concluídos com sucesso e dentro dos prazos/modelos estabelecidos.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato principal para os clientes durante a fase de implantação, promovendo uma comunicação clara e eficaz para entender as necessidades e expectativas.
  • Coordenar e orientar o time de implantação, promovendo o desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Garantir a aderência aos processos e metodologias definidas.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas da empresa para alinhar requisitos e resolver possíveis desafios que possam impactar o projeto.
  • Conduzir e monitorar o progresso dos projetos, aplicando metodologias de gerenciamento para manter controle de cronogramas, KPIs e escopo.
  • Garantir a aderência dos projetos aos processos de negócio dos clientes, especialmente em operações logísticas complexas.
  • Realizar diagnósticos operacionais e propor soluções técnicas e funcionais para otimizar o uso dos sistemas TMS/YMS.
  • Participar da definição de escopo funcional e técnico junto aos clientes e à equipe de produto.
  • Apoiar na gestão de mudanças organizacionais durante a implantação dos sistemas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos na coordenação equipes de implantação de software.
  • Certificação/Formação em Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, etc.).
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e liderança, com capacidade para tomar decisões assertivas e solucionar problemas de maneira proativa.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e de gestão de projetos (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK).
  • Vivência prática na implantação de sistemas, com entendimento dos processos logísticos envolvidos (roteirização, agendamento de docas, controle de pátio, tracking de entregas, etc.).
  • Capacidade de interpretar e traduzir requisitos operacionais em soluções tecnológicas.
